a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the operate-to-8 plan will very likely leave us both dead after round 1. I plan to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If you also take, the split is random and we may both end up short. So I'd suggest you operate or wait this round. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you every round after that to refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
